description: Show an upload panel in the conversation so the customer can drop in artwork that lives on their device — including a file they shared in this chat, which cannot be passed to a tool directly. Use this whenever someone wants stickers made from a file they have but no public image URL. They pick the file, see it, and get a button that opens the Bottle Your Brand order page with the artwork already attached. Prefer order_custom_stickers instead when a public https image URL is available.

artwork.description: Set by the upload panel itself. Never fill this in.

name: upload_sticker_artwork

product.description: Product key the upload panel orders for.

ready.description: Pre-loaded artwork; when present the panel shows it ready to order.

upload_url.description: Page to use if the panel cannot be shown.

title: Upload sticker artwork
